title: At least 36 trains robbed; 14 accused in $22.5 million Nike cargo theft racket in US
summary_full: Fourteen people have been indicted in the US for allegedly stealing over $22.5 million worth of cargo from at least 36 freight trains in Southern California. The stolen goods included Nike sneakers and Milwaukee tools, which were allegedly resold on the black market. Investigators claim the gang used social media to coordinate thefts and sales.
